name: CValues
description: CValues is the first Chinese human values evaluation benchmark designed to measure large language models' alignment with human values in terms of safety and responsibility. It includes adversarial safety prompts and responsibility prompts across multiple scenarios and domains, with both human and automatic multi-choice evaluations.
reputation: A notable Chinese safety and values benchmark that is frequently cited in alignment evaluations, though it is less established than major English-language safety benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on Chinese LLMs and includes both adversarial and responsibility prompts with human and automatic evaluation.
